project_type: Electron office suite monorepo. Target: redrob-office (pnpm + Turborepo, single @redrob/office Electron app + packages/*). Source to port wholesale: GenOffice (npm workspaces, 6 Electron apps docs/sheets/slides/pdf/markdown/shell + 13 TS packages, ~442,000 lines). Plus rhwp (Rust+WASM HWP/HWPX editor) embedded as the Hangul editor.
language: TypeScript (React 19 in GenOffice apps, React 18 in existing redrob office app), plus Rust (GenOffice sheets xlsx sidecar, rhwp WASM studio).
build_system: Target root: pnpm@9.15.0 + turbo (turbo.json tasks: build/dev/test/typecheck/lint/clean). Each GenOffice app builds via electron-vite. Root scripts in package.json. pnpm loaded via nvm: `export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22` then corepack provides pnpm. GenOffice's own build is npm workspaces (electron-vite per app; shell imports each app's src/main directly and hosts each renderer as a WebContentsView child).
test_framework: vitest across target packages (turbo run test). GenOffice uses vitest per package/app. rhwp-studio uses node --test + playwright e2e. Existing office app: vitest run.
build_command: From redrob-office root: `export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22; pnpm build` (turbo). Per ported app during staging: `pnpm --filter <pkg> build` or the app's electron-vite build.
test_command: From redrob-office root: `pnpm test` (turbo run test). Also `pnpm typecheck`. `pnpm lint` is a no-op. Headless UI check: `pnpm dev:web` (port 5173, browser mock bridge). Full Electron GUI cannot run in this VM (no GPU/display) - do not treat as failure.
verification_instructions: 1) `pnpm install` at root resolves the merged workspace. 2) `pnpm typecheck` passes (turbo). 3) `pnpm build` passes (turbo). 4) `pnpm test` passes (turbo). 5) `pnpm dev:web` boots the renderer. Full Electron end-to-end GUI and local GPU inference are NOT verifiable in this headless VM; document that limitation honestly but never shrink scope because of it. GenOffice's own suites can be run inside apps/ via their vitest configs where wired.
snapshot_or_generated_files: GenOffice: `tools/gen-third-party-notices.mjs` generates THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES for packaging (root script `npm run notices`); `npm run fixtures` (docx-engine) generates test .docx fixtures; `tools/build-stale-preloads.mjs` (predev) builds preloads; several `tools/build-*-font.py` regenerate bundled fonts. rhwp: rhwp-studio is a Rust+WASM+Vite build (`npm run build` in rhwp-studio produces dist/, requires Rust+wasm toolchain and dioxus-cli which may be incomplete in this VM). Preserve regeneration commands; do not hand-edit generated output.

contribution_requirements: Apache-2.0 (GenOffice) obligations MUST be honored: keep/port LICENSE, NOTICE (Mainfunc, Inc. copyright), LICENSE-UNICODE.txt, and reflect THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES in packaging. Rebrand product name GenOffice->Redrob and remove Genspark/GSK provider branding, but NEVER remove upstream copyright notices (Apache-2.0 section 4). rhwp is MIT (Copyright 2025-2026 Edward Kim) - preserve its license. Redrob invariants from redrob-office/AGENTS.md are binding: single Redrob engine only (no BYOK, no third-party provider names/selection UI), fixed Console route https://console.redrob.ai/api/backend/v1 with model redrob-ai / redrob/auto, honest-failure steering (redrob-code/steering.ts), NO em dashes in user-facing copy, shared UI via packages/ui shadcn, i18n en/ko key parity, offline-first (no unauthorized external calls). English-only in code/comments.
key_patterns: GenOffice shell architecture (THE pattern to port, not reinvent): apps/shell/src/main/tab-manager.ts owns a single BrowserWindow and mounts each editor app's renderer as a WebContentsView child; it imports each app's main-process entry directly (createDocsView from docs/src/main/docs-main, createSheetsView, createSlidesView, createPdfView, createMarkdownView). Each app = self-contained Electron workspace with src/main (Electron main), src/renderer (React 19 UI), src/shared (ipc types), tests/. AI layer: @genoffice/ai-provider is a BYOK multi-provider (Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/OpenAI/custom) imported by ALL apps + shell - this is the layer to REPLACE with the Redrob engine (office/src/main/redrob-code/*, services/chat.ts, tools/*). Redrob's existing host<->renderer seam is window.office/OfficeApi (see docs/tauri-vs-electron/00-analysis.md on rejected branch for the seam analysis). Host decision is Electron (confirmed PR #32). Theme tokens live in packages/ui/src/tokens.css (semantic tokens, per-app --accent). i18n sharded per locale under i18n/<domain>/<lang>.ts.
